svg.text: Live Broadcast OB Truck Intercom, 7s FCC Safety Delay & Host IFB Whisper Voice Architecture
7-Second Broadcast Delay Buffer Dump Lock (0% On-Air Breach) · Pause-Aware Host IFB Whisper · 0ms EAS / Master-Control Override
BROADCAST-OB-TRUCK-FCC-VOICE-01
1. OB Truck Matrix Intercom & Live Feeds
RTS ODIN / Clear-Com Eclipse · SMPTE ST 2110-30 / AES67
Live On-Air Program & Field Crowd Mics
• Play-by-play commentators + parabolic sideline mics
• Feeds 7.0s hardware broadcast delay buffer (Eventide)
Delay_Buffer_Headroom = 7,000ms_Pre_Transmitter
Anchor IFB (Interruptible Foldback) Bus
• Mix-Minus earpiece worn by live anchor / commentator
• Real-time VAD tracks anchor's active speaking state
Anchor_Mic_State = Speaking_On_Air | Pause_Window
EVS Replay, Sports Data & Teleprompter Bus
• Sportradar / Opta / Hawkeye live telemetry & EVS clip ID
• MOS protocol link to Ross Inception / ENPS prompter
Live_Stat_Trigger = "Player_23_Career_High_42_Pts"
FCC Part 79 / CEA-708 Closed-Caption Encoder
• Evertz / EEG Lexi HD-SDI closed-caption inserter

Caption_NER_Accuracy = 99.6% (FCC Quality Compliant)
2. Deterministic 7s Delay & IFB Whisper Gate
Zero On-Air Violation · Zero Anchor Talk-Over · 0ms EAS
Gate A: 7-Second Delay Buffer Safety Dump Lock
• Scans pre-air buffer at T-6.5s for FCC 18 USC 1464
profanity, doxxed PII, or broadcast safety redlines
• FiresGPI dump/mute relay at T-5.8s before RF uplink
On_Air_Broadcast_Violation_Leak = 0.0% (Hard Dumped)
Pre_Transmitter_Intercept_Margin = 5,800ms
Gate B: Pause-Synchronized IFB Whisper Gate
• Blocks AI stat whispers while anchor's Tally light is ON
and voice is active (prevents auditory speech jamming)
• Whispers <3-word cue in pause or pushes to prompter
Anchor_On_Air_Stumble_From_IFB = 0.0%
Live_Stat_And_Replay_Cue_Speed = 1.4s (vs 18s Manual)
Gate C: 0ms FEMA EAS & Dead-Air Master Preemption
• Detects National EAS / Tsunami / Amber alert trigger
or >3.0s unscheduled program dead-air / exciter trip
• Switches master router to emergency slate/EAS in 0ms
& bridges Technical Director (TD) + Master Control
if (easAlertOrMasterDeadAirFault) -> 0ms Master_Switch
P99_Gate_Latency = 19ms | EAS_Cutover_Delay = 0ms
3. Master Control & Accessibility Output
GPI Delay Dump · CEA-708 SAP · EVS Clip Tagging
Automated EVS Highlight & SAP Secondary Audio
• Voice-tags EVS replay angles ("Clip 114B Goal Angle")
• Generates Secondary Audio Program (SAP) Spanish/EN
and FCC Audio Description (AD) for blind viewers
CEA708_Caption_Display_Latency = 1.6s
OB Truck Producer & TD Intercom Matrix
• Isolates 64 party-line intercom channels on RTS ODIN
• Prevents internal truck talkback from leaking to air
• Logs FCC compliance check-sheet & EAS test timestamps
Talkback_To_Program_Bus_Leak = 0.0%
Benchmark & TCO Summary (1,000 Live Broadcasts)
• Manual Delay Button + Steno: $1,850,000 / 1k shows
• Hybrid 7s-Gate + IFB Copilot: $14,800 / 1k shows (Rec)
• Unfiltered Live Caption/IFB: $9,200 + $490k FCC fine risk
Avoided_FCC_Indecency_Penalty = $490,000 / Incident
Sideline_Curse_Catch = 100% | IFB_Collisions = 0%

Cloud & AI Solution Architect Takeaway — Live Broadcast OB Truck Intercom & Safety Delay Voice Copilot
Wire safety redline detection into the 7-second hardware delay buffer via GPI relay, and gate anchor IFB audio cues strictly on Tally/speech pause state.
